Name: Solid Foundations
Author: PeacefulEnd
Description:
[img]https://imgur.com/jvcglk2.png[/img]
[size=3][b]Solid Foundations[/b] is a framework which allows for custom buildings in Stardew Valley.

Solid Foundations introduces many features for custom buildings:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Dynamic, animation-supported texture overlays, with optional conditions[/size]
[*][size=3]Custom interiors[/size]
[*][size=3]Item production via user-defined rules[/size]
[*][size=3]Building skin variation[/size]
[*][size=3]Custom material cost and build rules[/size]
[*][size=3]Custom exterior collision[/size]
[*][size=3]Dynamic "touch" and "walk" player actions (such as warping when player walks on a tile)[/size]
[*][size=3]...and much more![/size]
[/list]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/e0yBHUE.png[/img]

[size=3]See the GitHub repository for an [url=https://github.com/Floogen/SolidFoundations/wiki]in-depth wiki[/url] on how to create a content pack for Solid Foundations.
[size=3]
See the example pack in the [b]Optional Files [/b]section for an example custom buildings pack.[/size][size=3]
See [url=https://github.com/Floogen/MysticalBuildings]Mystical Buildings[/url] for an SF pack which utilizes Solid Foundation's API.[/size]

[b][url=https://github.com/Floogen/AlternativeTextures/wiki/Content-Patcher-Integration]Content Patcher[/url] is supported!

[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]Dynamic Game Assets[/url] is supported!

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/444]Save Anywhere[/url] is supported![/b][/b][/size][b]


[img]https://imgur.com/elFaout.png[/img]
[size=3]To use this framework, you need a Solid Foundations content pack.
[/size][/b][size=3]These content packs will add the custom buildings to either Robin's or the Wizard's construction menu.

Removing downloaded SF packs will result in their respective building disappearing from your map, with no other impact on your save file.[/size][b][size=3]


[img]https://imgur.com/McBoaEB.png[/img]
[/size][/b][size=3]For a general example pack, see the [url=https://github.com/Floogen/SolidFoundations/tree/development/SolidFoundations/Examples]mod's repository[/url].

[/size][size=3]For a pack which uses Solid Foundation and Content Patcher (as well as Solid Foundation's API), see the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12312]Mystical Buildings pack.[/url][/size][b]



[img]https://imgur.com/EMDafPl.png[/img]
[size=3][b]Can I uninstall Solid Foundation without issue?[/b]
[/size][/b][list]
[*][size=3]Yes, though any placed custom buildings will disappear. Re-installing Solid Foundations will result in your custom buildings being restored.[/size]
[/list][b]
[size=3][b]Can I uninstall Solid Foundation content packs without issue?
[/b][/size][/b][list]
[*][size=3]Yes, though the respective custom buildings will disappear. If you re-install the SF content pack before saving, the custom buildings will be restored. Otherwise they will be lost.[/size]
[/list][b]
[size=3]What are the limitations?
[/size][/b][list]
[*][size=3][url=https://github.com/Floogen/SolidFoundations/wiki/Framework-Limitations]See here[/url]﻿﻿ for the current list of unsupported features.[/size]
[/list]

Source code is [url=https://github.com/Floogen/SolidFoundations]available here[/url].
